method: pp.4-6 and p.15 rendered from the vector strokes with the pure-python pypdf renderer (1.0-10.0 px/pt, rotated 90) and read visually; text on these pages is drawn as strokes (no text layer). Readings record which line a printed dimension or label attaches to; nothing was measured by plotted scale. Renders stay in the session scratchpad; only their hashes are kept here.

p15_slab_on_beams_detail.title: TYP.SLAB ON BEAMS DETAIL
printed_labels: TOP ANCHOR BARS. FOR SIZE & SPACING SEE SCHEDULE OR PLAN
BOTTOM BARS. FOR SIZE & SPACING SEE SCHDULE OR PLAN
EXTEND 50% OF TOP REINF. INTO ADJACENT SLAB WHERE POSSIBLE
STOP 50% OF BOT. REINF. BALANCE CONTINUOUS

span_basis.L1: CLEAR_SPAN - the L1 dimension line runs from the inner face of the non-continuous support to the face of the continuous beam and is labelled CLEAR SPAN
span_basis.L2: CLEAR_SPAN - the L2 dimension line starts at the far face of the continuous beam and is labelled CLEAR SPAN

dimension_attachment.TOP_ANCHOR_NON_CONTINUOUS: 0.25 L1: from the inner face of the non-continuous support to the end of the top anchor bar
dimension_attachment.TOP_CONTINUOUS_WHICHEVER_LARGER: 0.30 max(L1, L2): from the end of the top bar to the face of the continuous beam; drawn on the L1 side only - the extent on the L2 side is drawn (the bar continues across the beam) but not dimensioned
dimension_attachment.BOTTOM_50PCT_STOP: 0.125 L1 / 0.125 L2: from each face of the continuous beam to the end of the stopped bottom bars; the balance bottom bars run continuous through the beam

p15_slab_on_beams_detail.non_continuous_support: the top anchor bar turns down into the support (leg drawn, not dimensioned); a bottom bar runs into the support; '40 CL.' is dimensioned from the outer face of the support but the bar it binds is not legible at the drawn scale

covers.25 CL: vertical: slab soffit to the bottom bars
horizontal: at the outer face of the non-continuous support (binding unclear)

p15_slab_on_beams_detail.nts_status: TYPICAL_DETAIL - values only from the printed text; no length is scaled from the figure

notes: 1. LAP LENGHT FOR ALL TEMPERATUERE BARS SHALL BE 40xDIA.
2. WHERE BEAMS ARE PARALLEL TO MAIN SLAB REINFORCEMENT PROVIDE TEMP. REINF. X 2000 TOP OF SLAB AT RIGHT ANGLES TO BEAMS. 1000 @ SPANDREL
3. WHERE TOP REINF. DIFFERS BETWEEN ADJACENT SPANS USE LAGER REINF.
